repo: Phase 60 has 8 plans across 4 waves; Wave 4 (60-08) is non-autonomous (requires human action: staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test).

workflow: Mid-edit compiler diagnostics can be stale snapshots — always re-run cargo check authoritatively before flagging a compile failure from executor output.
Sequential subagent mode (no worktree isolation) is safer for crypto-sensitive phases where merge correctness is critical, trading wall-clock time for correctness.
The GSD workflow's wave execution model gates phase verification/completion on all incomplete plans finishing, even when running a subset wave.
